home.role: Senior front-end engineer in Boulder, Colorado
home.blurb: 10+ years of experience building accessible, interactive web experiences. Combines design thinking, a strong visual eye, and a knack for troubleshooting to ship polished work in close partnership with designers and content teams.

design.title: Design
design.text: Design thinking and a strong visual eye. I prototype in Figma and turn designs into polished, responsive interfaces in close partnership with designers and content teams.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.text: Building to WCAG 2.1 AA from the start. I led an accessibility audit of a 34-product interactive learning library, prototyped fixes and delivered a roadmap for improvements.

interactive.text: Rich, playful experiences in Vue and TypeScript with creative libraries like d3.js, pixi.js, p5.js and GreenSock.
